<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item from the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is only used in the creation of {{Item|Memory tincture}}. After obtaining the [[Vampires jaw]] and talking to [[Clotho]], she gives you three memory powder and the recipe for memory tincture. Additional memory powders can be bought from her for {{Money|1000}} each.
